journey.name: EXC-08: 接口超时与服务端故障响应场景
journey.description: 验证网关服务出现 500 内部错误、504 网关超时或 SSE 长连接异常断开时，应用能解析错误协议包，将失败原因清晰展示在状态卡片中，并提供重连机制，确保端侧状态可控。

actions.action: Verify that the "网关地址" input field is visible on screen
Click the "网关地址" input field
Type "https://server-error-500.example.local:8443" into the "网关地址" field
Click the "用户名 / 账号" input field
Type "test_user" into the "用户名 / 账号" field
Click the "访问凭据 / 密码" input field
Type "test_pass" into the "访问凭据 / 密码" field
Verify that the failure state banner displays the protocol error message
Verify that the "重试" button is available
Verify that the error state is cleared and reconnect is attempted
